answer: Require each agent to post a refundable economic bond tied to one identity. Sybil swarms then cost real capital per fake, so flooding the network strips an attacker bare like a gale tearing through an orchard. Honest agents accrue attested history in a shared reputation lagoon, and any misbehavior slashes the bond. When forging thousands of identities costs more than it earns, the sybil strategy simply stops paying.
